Ministry of Road Transport & Highways (Government of India)
The Ministry of Road Transport & Highways (Government of India) issued a notification regarding the 'Automatic Headlamp ON' feature.

GSR 188 (E)
GSR 188 (E) is the notification number issued by the Ministry of Road Transport & Highways.

Automatic Headlamp ON
The 'Automatic Headlamp ON' feature is a lighting system mandated for all 2 Wheelers by the Ministry of Road Transport & Highways.

A global sports competition featuring top athletes in track and field.

Noah Carter
Noah Carter is a sprinter who set a new record in the 100m sprint at the World Athletics Championship.

100m Sprint Record
The 100m sprint record is a benchmark in athletics, recently broken by Noah Carter.

Odometer
Displays the accumulated distance traveled by the vehicle.

Tripmeter
Displays the distance traveled per trip, resettable to zero.

Real Time Mileage Indicator (RTMI)
Shows the current mileage of the vehicle in km/litre, refreshed every 3 seconds.

Fuel Gauge
Indicates the approximate amount of fuel available in the fuel tank using segments on the display.

Low Fuel Indicator
A warning indicator that illuminates when the fuel level is low.

Service Reminder Indicator
Indicates when the vehicle is due for service, blinking based on kilometers covered.

Passing Switch
A switch that gives an indication for passing ahead.

Clutch Switch
A switch provided for the safety of the rider, preventing the vehicle from starting unless the clutch lever is operated when the vehicle is engaged in gear.

Headlamp Dimmer Switch
A switch to select high or low beam for the headlamp.
